author: Bellular News
description:
How many games have been sitting on your Steam wishlist for years? New releases are struggling to turn that interest into sales, and Valve has changed how wishlists work to help. With more players waiting for discounts, developers need their games to keep selling long after launch.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
